resources.string: Hold volume buttons to skip tracks

Lets you hold volume-up to skip to the next track and volume-down to go to the previous track while audio is playing, even with the screen off. Short presses change the volume as usual. This service only reads volume button presses; it does not read screen content.

While audio is playing:

• Hold volume-up → next track
• Hold volume-down → previous track
• Short press → normal volume change

Works with the screen off. When nothing is playing, the volume buttons behave normally.
